nodes.description: Private owner address; gates init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and delegate.
Public mapping address=>uint holding token balances; mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping address=>address=>uint of spending allowances.
Private mapping address=>uint256 counting how many times an address has sold.
Private mapping address=>bool whitelist consulted by ensure().
Private minimum sale amount threshold checked in condition().
Private maximum sale amount threshold checked in condition().
Private number of allowed sales per address checked in condition().
Address whitelisted in ensure() and settable by the owner via setTradeAddress.
Public total token supply set in the constructor.
msg.sender: used as authorization principal, as allowance spender and as transfer origin.
Unsafe delegatecall to an arbitrary caller-supplied address with arbitrary calldata in delegate().
Unchecked arithmetic: allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value, balanceOf[_from] -= _value, balanceOf[_to] += _value.
Unchecked arithmetic: total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total.
transfer(address,uint) payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Internal view whitelist gate: allows owner, UNI, computed pair, tradeAddress or canSale addresses; otherwise enforces condition().
transferFrom(address,address,uint) payable; spends allowance, calls ensure(), mutates balances and _onSaleNum.
approve(address,uint) payable; sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale policy check against _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
delegate(address,bytes) payable; owner-only arbitrary delegatecall, executes untrusted code in this contract context.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum from calldata.
Owner-only batch transfer looping over a user-supplied recipient array and emitting two half-value Transfer events.
Owner-only setter for tradeAddress.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation from factory and token pair.
payable constructor; sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner=msg.sender, initial balance and infinite UNI allowance.
